#OnThisDay: November 22, 2014
Cops killed 12 year old #TamirRice. Someone called police saying there was a person, probably a “juvenile,” with a gun “probably fake.” Dispatch did not relay this info. An officer fired within 2 seconds after arriving. No one was indicted.
